method: 15 parallel fresh-context reviewer subagents over per-category contact sheets + per-tile frames; 34 shader/edge-flagged tiles re-captured on the REAL Metal GPU (webgpu) and re-judged.

brokenReclassified.okNote: Flagged broken under SwiftShader/at a sparse capture phase; render correctly on the real Metal GPU (plasma=vivid, nebula=cloud structure, supernova=burst orb, sparkle-glints=glint field, parallax-layers=depth-layer separation by design, bounce=card in-frame, collision-balls=renders but sparse).

artPolishFlag.clouds: flat blue gradient, no cloud density/structure (flat on real Metal GPU too)
artPolishFlag.fog: flat grey gradient, no volumetric drift (flat on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.godray: flat tan gradient, no light shafts (flat on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.dappled-light: flat grey-green fill, dapple pattern not reading (flat on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.ink-bloom: flat dark-navy fill, bloom not visible at captured phase (real GPU)
artPolishFlag.ink-spread: very faint glow blob, caught at low-energy spread phase (real GPU)
artPolishFlag.smoke: blocky low-res value-noise tiling, not soft smoke (blocky on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.fog-roll: blocky low-res noise tiling (blocky on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.mist-drift: blocky low-res noise tiling (blocky on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.wispy-smoke: blocky low-res shards, very coarse (blocky on real GPU)
artPolishFlag.fireball-burst: blocky + desaturated teal, wrong fire color, no warm tones (real GPU)
artPolishFlag.pointer-displace: flat blue plane at rest, card title/text not carried onto displaced mesh (real GPU)

fixNote: Every art-flagged tile still RENDERS (non-blank), PLAYS (uniforms advance — contract vitest green), and its CONTROLS work. None meet the FIX bar (does-not-render / does-not-play / control-does-nothing / contract-or-tsc regression). All are art-polish, carried to the dedicated art-polish step.
